summary: Enhance your skills with our Integrated Community Development Training Course. Learn effective strategies for community engagement and sustainable development.
lede: Community development training connects local priorities with measurable programme outcomes and sustainable enterprise decisions. It is designed for community development officers, programme managers, monitoring and evaluation specialists, and social enterprise leaders who need to plan and assess initiatives. Learners practise mapping stakeholders, building a Theory of Change and indicators, evaluating outcomes, and shaping sustainable community business models.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who connect community priorities, programme delivery, measurement, leadership, and sustainable enterprise decisions. It supports foundation to intermediate development, so you can apply established tools without needing advanced statistics, finance, or programming experience.
modules: Theory of Change and Logical Frameworks
M&E Indicators, Baselines, and Data Quality
prerequisites: You should have some exposure to community programmes, nonprofit operations, social enterprise, sustainability, monitoring and evaluation, or project coordination. No advanced statistics, accounting, or programming experience is required. You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software; familiarity with Excel is useful. The exercises use provided datasets and templates, so you do not need to prepare organizational data before attending.
